description: overallScore = 100 * sum(statusWeights[status] for each non-excluded applicable ControlAssessment) / count(non-excluded applicable ControlAssessments). coveragePercent = assessedControls / applicableControls * 100, where assessedControls counts everything except NOT_TESTED (N/A and ACCEPTED_RISK are excluded from applicableControls entirely, matching excludedStatuses). Each domainScores[] entry's score uses this identical formula, scoped to that domain's ControlAssessment records only. Within a domain, totalControls = passCount + failCount + partialCount + notTestedCount + notApplicableCount + acceptedRiskCount (every control in the domain, regardless of applicability); applicableControls = totalControls - notApplicableCount - acceptedRiskCount; assessedControls = applicableControls - notTestedCount.
